title: National Association of Realtors Political Action Committee spent $906.7K supporting Leigh Brown for the House (NC-09)
summary: National Association of Realtors Political Action Committee reported $906,670.00 supporting Leigh Brown for the House (NC-09): TV Ad buy and production costs, paid to Strategic Partners & Media, Inc. Seen from 2019-04-16; reported 2019-04-18, as filed with the FEC.
